I am currently a Postdoctoral Research Associate at the [Centre for Crop and Disease Management (CCDM)](https://www.ccdm.com.au/) at Curtin University in Western Australia, working under the supervision of [Associate Professor Julia Easton](https://www.ccdm.com.au/people/julia-easton/) and [Professor Adam Spark](https://www.ccdm.com.au/people/adam-sparks/).

I obtained my PhD in Mathematics and Statistics from the Department of Econometrics and Business Statistics at the [Monash University, Australia](https://www.monash.edu/business/ebs) in 2026 under the supervision [Professor Dianne Cook](http://www.dicook.org/), [Dr. Michael Lydeamore](https://research.monash.edu/en/persons/michael-lydeamore), [Dr. Thiyanga S. Talagala](https://thiyanga.netlify.app/), and [Dr. Paul Harrison](https://research.monash.edu/en/persons/paul-harrison). My doctoral thesis can be found in [https://jayani-lakshika-phd-thesis.netlify.app/](https://jayani-lakshika-phd-thesis.netlify.app/).

I was part of [Monash NUMBATs](https://numbat.space/). Previously, I am worked as a Teaching Associate and Research Assistant in Department of Econometrics and Business Statistics at the [Monash University, Australia](https://www.monash.edu/business/ebs).
